subject: expression: introduce `StaticEvalContext` to provide context when evaluating expressions (#52631)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs first parent, focusing on `pkg/expression/contextstatic/evalctx.go`, `pkg/expression/context/context.go`, `pkg/expression/contextsession/sessionctx.go`, `pkg/sessionctx/stmtctx/stmtctx.go`, and the executor/store adaptations. `StaticEvalContext` correctly satisfies `exprctx.EvalContext` (deterministic `CurrentTime`, warning handling via `contextutil.WarnHandler`, privilege hooks defaulting consistent with session behavior), and the warning/`SQLWarn` refactor preserves levels and JSON (un)marshal behavior via `pkg/util/context/warn.go`. No Blocker/High issues found in correctness, SQL warning semantics/visibility, privilege checks, or session/executor/store runtime behavior for this change; later upstream commits show follow-up feature/refactor work around static contexts/warnings without indicating a regression fix for this commit.
